rules.source_quote: Farmers must possess a valid and authenticated land ownership certificate or a valid land tenure agreement.
rules.note: The passage also allows a land tenure agreement, and ELIGIBILITY-03 covers tenant farmers and sharecroppers, so owns_cultivable_land eq true may wrongly exclude tenants.

unresolved: CONFLICT: PMFBY-IN-ELIGIBILITY-03 includes tenant farmers and sharecroppers, while a strict ownership reading of PMFBY-IN-ELIGIBILITY-04 (land ownership certificate) would exclude them; the passage actually says 'ownership certificate or tenure agreement'. Rule R01 needs human review and may need a tenure-agreement field instead.
